value.rationale: The primary source explicitly motivates classification of threshold q-access structures. Rank two is the first nontrivial total rank where ports can have dimension at least two, and the theorem gives a complete rigidity criterion for this slice: all rank-one secret ports are threshold exactly when the rank function is uniform. This provides a structural diagnostic for code-induced access structures, rather than a routine finite census or a numerical recomputation.
